init_FrankaPanda: create a FrankaPanda instance with default grasp offset and max grasp distance
apply_grasp_offset: apply the grasp offset matrix to an end effector pose using FrankaPanda
get_grasp_offset: access the FrankaPanda grasp offset 4x4 transformation matrix for the robot end effector
get_max_grasp: access the FrankaPanda max grasp distance value of 0.08 meters
review_FrankaPanda_class: review the FrankaPanda class and its grasp offset application for the robot
